title.zh: 阅读体验、容器与跨端适配
title.en: Reading experience, containers and cross-device fit

text.zh:
图表与图内文字在实际展示尺寸下必须清晰可读，禁止挤在小容器中。检查文字换行、图文环绕位置和图文对齐，优先保持读者理解的连贯性并降低阅读成本。长段文字按逻辑组合，结构化内容以结构化形式呈现。

容器内正文应完整展开，避免把一段本可正常阅读的文字放入小型局部滚动区域，使读者反复拖动滚动条。排版材料同时满足移动端和 PC 端的阅读要求，分别核对实际展示效果。
text.en:
Charts and the text inside them must be clearly readable at their actual display size; do not cram them into small containers. Check text wrapping, text-and-image flow and alignment; keep the reader's understanding coherent first and lower the reading cost. Group long passages by logic and present structured content in structured form.

Body text inside a container should be fully expanded; do not put a passage that could be read normally into a small local scroll area that forces the reader to keep dragging scrollbars. Typeset material must meet both mobile and PC reading requirements, with the actual display checked on each.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 制作含图表、图内文字、长段文字或其他排版内容的材料时
trigger.en: When producing material with charts, text inside charts, long passages or other typeset content

purpose.zh: 保证读者在实际展示尺寸下，以及移动端和 PC 端上都能顺畅阅读
purpose.en: Ensure readers can read smoothly at the actual display size, on both mobile and PC

exclude.zh: 不含图表与排版要求的简短文字回复
exclude.en: Short text replies with no charts or typesetting requirements
